fusions.name: Crevice Lunge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 5 tiles to the target and bite, dealing 12 damage, making it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Follow Me Across
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Sharp coral rises underfoot and deals 8 slashing damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 60% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sudden Reef
fusions.desc: Raises a reef 5 tiles long across the ground for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Polyp by Polyp
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
